description: Search property listings on Morizon.pl, a major Polish real-estate portal: flats, houses, plots, commercial premises, offices, garages and rooms, for sale or for rent, filtered by location (any Polish city, district, town, village, county or voivodeship), price, area, rooms, private sellers only and primary/secondary market, sorted like the site. Returns one results page (up to 35 listings) with each listing's price, price per m², area, rooms, floor, location, seller and link; pass a listing `id` to morizon_offer for the full details. Morizon.pl shows the same listings as Gratka.pl (one platform, different ids and links): search one portal, not both, and use morizon_offer only with Morizon.pl ids. Fetched live from Morizon.pl's own API (typically under 1 s). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, heading, resolved_location, total_count, page, total_pages, count, listings: [...], note? } — the list key is `listings`; `total_count` counts matches across all pages (use `page` for more); `resolved_location` is the place `location` was matched to. Each listing: { source, id, url, title, category, kind, development, price, price_per_m2, currency, area_m2, rooms, floor, location, street, district, city, region, seller_type, seller_name, date_posted, refreshed_at, image, photo_count, description }. Prices are numbers in PLN (for rent, `price` is the monthly rent) and area is in m²; fields are null when the listing omits them. `kind` is 'new_development' for a developer's unit in a new project (named in `development`), else 'listing'; `seller_type` is agency | private | developer. An empty match answers count: 0 with a `note` saying why and what to change — that is a successful result, not an error.

area_max.description: Maximum area in m² (the plot's area for type 'plot').

area_min.description: Minimum area in m² (the plot's area for type 'plot').

location.description: Where, as a Polish place name, matched by the site's own location search: a city ('Kraków'), a district ('Warszawa Mokotów', 'Gdańsk Wrzeszcz'), a town or village, a county ('krakowski') or a whole voivodeship ('mazowieckie'). Diacritics are optional; English names other than Warsaw/Cracow are not recognised. Omit to search all of Poland.

market.description: 'primary' = new build from a developer (rynek pierwotny), 'secondary' = resale (rynek wtórny).

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

page.description: Results page, 1-based (35 listings per page). Default 1.

price_max.description: Maximum total price in PLN (monthly rent when transaction is 'rent').

price_min.description: Minimum total price in PLN (monthly rent when transaction is 'rent').

private_only.description: Only listings posted by private owners — no agencies or developers. Default false.

rooms_max.description: Maximum number of rooms — not for types 'plot' and 'garage' (use min = max for exactly N).

rooms_min.description: Minimum number of rooms — not for types 'plot' and 'garage'.

sort.description: Order: 'newest' (recently added), 'price_asc' / 'price_desc', 'price_per_m2_asc' / 'price_per_m2_desc', 'area_asc' / 'area_desc'. Default: the site's own order (recently refreshed).

transaction.description: 'sale' = na sprzedaż (buying), 'rent' = na wynajem (renting; prices are monthly).

type.description: Property type: 'flat' = mieszkanie, 'house' = dom, 'plot' = działka/grunt (land), 'commercial' = lokal użytkowy (any commercial premises), 'office' = biuro, 'garage' = garaż, 'room' = pokój (a room to rent — rent only).

name: morizon_search
title: Search Polish real-estate listings (Morizon.pl)
